recommendation: Keep the empty core audit commit. Future edits to valueset-otherName or valueset-otherTitle should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack repository unless a later work-group decision specifically changes core ValueSet guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-25395 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core ValueSet. It requested fixing the misleading valueset-otherName extension by aligning other-name with FHIR Resource.name semantics and adding valueset-otherTitle for alternate human-readable ValueSet titles, including preference/language support.
initial_application: No core commit explicitly tagged FHIR-25395 was found. Core commit 054eabf311 re-applied the R5 ValueSet extension work after an earlier reverted attempt, updated valueset-otherName from human-readable title semantics to machine-processing-friendly name semantics, added valueset-otherTitle, and listed the new StructureDefinition in the ValueSet implementation guide. Commit 803f660585 later updated the active ValueSet notes to say VSD Name aligns with ValueSet.title and to point language/preference needs to valueset-otherTitle.
additional_context: Commit dd468d4f17 removed the ValueSet extension definition source files from core during the R5 extension migration. Current core retains active ValueSet notes and OID registrations but no active source definitions for valueset-otherName or valueset-otherTitle. The current FHIR Extension Pack source marks valueset-otherName deprecated/retired in favor of valueset-otherTitle and defines valueset-otherTitle with title, preferred, and language slices. Later same-family issue FHIR-44727 is already represented on the combined branch by commit 56d26bf5f8.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The audit commit records that the current core checkout should not recreate or edit the extension definitions because they live in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions, while core's active ValueSet guidance already reflects the corrected title/name distinction.
